Q5.q: Q5. Is the gym free or do you pay?
Q5.a: The VGU Gym charges a membership fee, which this student describes as highly reasonable and affordable for almost every student. Actinium Gym, just outside campus, is the more premium option.

meta.meta_description: The NSGC president on what the NIAT Student General Council actually does at NIAT Jaipur: raising student issues, running clubs and keeping everyone informed.
Panache is VGU Jaipur's seven-day festival every March: classes suspended, 140+ competitions, each department given an Indian state, one trophy at stake.
